newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crude diffs wide in last of Aug activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crude diffs wide in last of Aug activity.

text.p: U.S. cash crude differentials closed out August trade with wide talk between a few remaining buyers and sellers, traders said on Friday.
September West Texas Intermediate/Midland was trading in line with NYMEX at $19.85-95 a barrel, up around 10-15 cents from late on Thursday.
The August/September WTI roll traded at minus 18, 20 and 23 cents a barrel, with the last trade again at minus 20 cents.
The only fresh August activity was seen in Posting Plus, which was dealt at $1.80 a barrel.
August WTI/Midland was talked at minus 32-25 cents, while Heavy Louisiana Sweet/Empire was at minus 40-20 cents.
August Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James was at either side of flat, although September LLS traded at plus 22 and 23 cents a barrel.
August West Texas Sour/Midland was also wide at minus $1.65-1.45 a barrel, while sparsely trade Eugene Island was valued at minus $1.60.
Friday was the deadline for pipeline scheduling, wrapping up cash activity for August. September activity begins in earnest on Monday.
